content.short: Mini app platform that adds eSIMs, bill payments, travel and remittance to any app.
content.description: Boxo lets a company turn its app into a super app through one integration. Partners pick from ready-made mini apps covering eSIMs, remittance, bill payments, insurance, airport lounges and hotel booking, and can launch new services in weeks. In World App, Boxo powers the eSIM mini app, which sells mobile data for travel.
content.meta: Boxo plugs eSIMs, remittance, bill pay and travel into any app via one integration, and runs the eSIM mini app in World App.
